tours.label: Start a site from a skeleton
tours.message: The 9 skeletons HAXcms ships, the use case each serves and the theme each starts from.

scenes.caption: A skeleton is a full working site you can start from and hand to someone else.
Courses, portfolios, a blog, docs, a club site and a plain starter.
Each one serves a use case.
Each one starts from a theme; open Themes to see them.
The CLI creates sites from skeletons; Winston built the templating.
Skeletons, use cases and themes together.
